title: wg: combiner-02 L325 Line 131 makes a Remove Commit itself a FULL Commit, while line 325...
description:
draft-ietf-mls-combiner (combiner-02), 3.2 Removing a Group Member. Editors' copy mlswg/mls-combiner at 380f0e1, L325.

Text: "User removals MUST be done in both PQ and traditional sessions followed by"

Problem: Line 131 makes a Remove Commit itself a FULL Commit, while line 325 reads as a Remove in each group followed by a separate FULL Commit Update. Implementations can follow either procedure.

Suggested fix: State that a Remove MUST be committed as a single FULL Commit (Remove' in PQ, and Remove plus the 0x0006 PSK proposal in T), and drop 'followed by a FULL Commit Update'.

Severity: medium. Verifier: keep (Confirmed. Line 131 makes Remove Commits combined (FULL) Commits, but line 325 describes removal in both sessions 'followed by' a FULL Commit Update, which reads as two steps.)

From MLS audit workflow wf_581e61f8-b25 (2026-10-21). Not yet reviewed by Mark; nothing posted upstream.
